description: enables the default permissions for the CHROME webview. Scoped by `webviews`, not `windows`, on purpose: the content webviews are CHILD webviews of the `main` window, so a `windows: ["main"]` list matches their WINDOW label too and would grant every tab the chrome's full `ipc` — `settings.set`, `nav.navigate`, every channel. That was harmless while there was no app ACL manifest (custom commands from a remote origin were refused outright), and would have become a real hole the moment the manifest was added. `webviews: ["main"]` matches the chrome webview only, because a content webview's label is `content:<id>`.
